title: Chuyến tàu nửa đêm
about: Round x16 (album 11), the user: "hãy sáng tác album 11", after album 10 (electronic sleep) was kept whole: more electronic sleep ambient (style ngu-dt), slow (52 bpm), pad, pianoarp, sub, strings, an improvised glass tune with a long echo. No drums. Remade before release on a less common progression of its own (the user, after Content ID matches on plain i-VI-iv-V pieces: "ok làm lại album 11 an toàn hơn"). An original piece.
